title: Ol' Man River

evidence.note: Wikipedia states the song was published in 1927 by T. B. Harms Co. and premiered in the original Broadway production of Show Boat on December 27, 1927; Hammerstein had drafted the lyrics as early as 1925 while the show was being written, but publication was with the show in 1927.
The official Rodgers & Hammerstein organization site credits the song '©1927 by Chappel & Co., Inc.'

famous_use: Paul Robeson's performance in the 1936 film adaptation of Show Boat is widely considered the most famous rendition.
